messages:
Lena Ortiz: Quick note 12-seat Accelerator Lab Sprint request from OrionRx (customer renewal in 8w). They want a 75m workshop focusing on onboarding velocity, CI for model deploys, and a short renewal healthcheck. Can we schedule next Tue to hit EMEA/APAC overlap?
Diego Morales: I can lead the CI/deploy part. Prefer 14:00-15:15 UTC so it catches late EMEA and early APAC. How many seats?
Lena Ortiz: They asked for 12 participants (4 infra, 6 eng, 2 PMs). Also want breakout rooms for hands-on pairing.
Nina Chang: Agenda suggestion: 10m intro + 20m CI/deploy walkthrough + 25m paired lab (2 breakouts) + 15m renewal pulse/feedback. That fits 70m; we're OK with 75m to give buffer.
Diego Morales: Need a sanitized repo snapshot and ephemeral creds for the lab. Can CS request that from customer?
Lena Ortiz: I'll ask OrionRx for a sanitized snapshot and attendee list. Also proposing a 3-question pre-survey to tailor the breakout labs.
Cal (calendar-bot): Provisional event created: OrionRx Accelerator Lab Sprint  provisional on CS calendar. Link: https://calendar.redwood.example/event/orionrx-accelerator. Poll posted: `poll: ["14:00-15:15 UTC", "15:30-16:45 UTC"]` Closes in 3h.
Nina Chang: Breakout logistics: we'll need two hosts for the paired lab. Diego + me? Also set up two ephemeral channels for each breakout and a shared lab repo.
Diego Morales: Happy to host breakout A. I'll prep a short runner script and a troubleshooting checklist.
Remy (forms-bot): Suggested feedback form created: https://forms.gle/redwood-orionrx-feedback. Questions include "top remaining risk", "confidence after session (1-5)", "interest in follow-up runbook workshop".
Lena Ortiz: For renewal signals please flag any "high risk" blockers from the feedback form and add notes to the renewal doc. I'll compile and surface to AMs.
Cal (calendar-bot): Poll closed  majority picked `14:00-15:15 UTC`. Event confirmed and invites sent. Recording enabled; breakouts pre-created; channel: #orionrx-accelerator-lab.
Nina Chang: Shared drive: https://drive.redwood.example/orionrx-accelerator (agenda, prework, runbooks). I'll post host runbooks and breakout assignments there.
Lena Ortiz: Thanks team 1et's move execution to #orionrx-accelerator-lab and close this scheduling thread.
